messages:
lina: Heads-up — ACME is asking for parity on per-tenant routing controls (they framed it as "must-have" for pilot). Need quick decision: full parity vs minimal shim + roadmap.
omar: can you paste the exact ask?
marie: summary from SE: tenant-level route weights, simple denylist, and a per-route fallback priority. Not the full policy language.
lina: exactly. they want: set route weight (0-100), set a fallback model, and opt-out caching.
cheng: infra cost estimate: rough delta if we do full policy engine ~= +25% CPU on routing tier and more complex rollout. Minimal shim (weights + fallback) is doable within current infra for pilot.
omar: tradeoff: shim is quick but couples a few codepaths in runtime. full engine is cleaner but takes 8-10w.
tess: from sales: ACME will sign a pilot with a clause to expand if parity exists. If we drag, risk them going to competitor. Pilot revenue + logo worth pushing.
lina: proposal: ship minimal parity for pilot (2w) + commit to a scoped policy engine in Q3 (8w). Launch criteria: (1) p50 request latency <= current +15ms; (2) per-tenant routing config stored in KV with audit logs; (3) can rollback per-tenant via console.
noah: UX checklist: admin view with weight slider, fallback dropdown, caching toggle. We can reuse the existing route UI patterns. Mockups in 3d.
omar: engineering checklist: spike to validate runtime keys: how to wire fallback model selection with current smart routing. Estimate 2 devs * 2w for shim + 1w ops.
cheng: quick config example for shim:```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "routes": [
    {"name":"default","weight":100,"fallback":"gpt-small","cache":true}
  ]
}
```
marie: SE note: ensure we expose an API visibility endpoint so ACME can audit decisions (they asked for deterministic fallback logs).
tess: commercial asks: need an explicit calendar commitment to full policy engine in writing if pilot goes green.
lina: agree. I'll draft a one-pager for legal/commercial. Quick Q: do we need a canary or per-tenant feature flag?
omar: yes — per-tenant FF is mandatory. We can gate via config; ops can flip.
rollout-bot: deploy plan created: "parity-shim/rc1" -> canary on dedicated pool -> global. ETA 2w if approved.
lina: decision: ship minimal parity shim with FF, required audit logs, and formal commit for full policy engine in Q3. Action items: @omar kickoff spike, @noah mockups, @cheng ops audit log schema, @tess draft customer commitment, @marie run pilot checklist.
omar: starting spike today. Will post findings in this thread.
noah: mockups in Figma by EOD Thursday.
cheng: will sketch audit schema and KV docs by Friday.
marie: pilot checklist ready to run once shim is staged.
tess: I'll share proposed contract language tomorrow. :thumbsup:
lina: thanks all. keeping this thread as the source of truth.
